tactics: exact fun F => (List.Mem.rec (motive := fun l t => List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t) (fun as => ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩) (fun b h ih => ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2)⟩) t).2

intro F; have key : ∀ (l : List α) (t : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t := by intro l t; induction t with | head as => exact ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2)⟩
intro F; induction t <;> apply F <;> constructor <;> simp_all
